help.title: Help & Support
help.subtitle: We're here to help. Find answers below or reach out to our support team.
help.faq1Q: How long does a consultation take?
help.faq1A: The AI intake takes about 10 minutes. A licensed doctor will review and respond within 2-4 hours.
help.faq2Q: How many tokens does a consultation cost?
help.faq2A: Each consultation costs 3 tokens. Tokens never expire and can be purchased in the app.
help.faq3A: Yes! Our doctors can issue MOH-compliant e-prescriptions directly through the app.
help.faq4A: Absolutely. All data is encrypted end-to-end and shared only with your assigned doctor. We follow strict privacy standards.
help.faq5A: Currently we offer Dermatology and Family Medicine, with more specialties coming soon.

photo.instructionsTitle: How to take a good medical photo
photo.tip1: Use good, natural lighting — avoid flash
photo.tip2: Hold the phone 15–30 cm (6–12 in) from the area
photo.tip3: Place a coin next to the lesion for size reference
photo.tip4: Take one close-up and one wider shot showing location
photo.tip5: Photograph from directly above (not at an angle)
photo.tip6: Make sure the image is in focus before submitting
